## A widget in the text

This small widget runs in your browser as part of the page. Move the slider
to see how the number of grid points changes the approximation of a normal
distribution.

```python {.marimo}
#| echo: false
import marimo as mo
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

points = mo.ui.slider(3, 60, value=8, label="Grid points")
points
```

```python {.marimo}
#| echo: false
grid = np.linspace(-4, 4, points.value)
density = np.exp(-0.5 * grid**2)
density /= density.sum()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 2.5))
ax.vlines(grid, 0, density, color="#0f6e74", linewidth=2)
ax.set_yticks([])
ax.spines[["left", "top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
fig.tight_layout()
ax
```
